title: Chelsea's starters, 2019 Europa League final
brief: Name the ten outfield players Chelsea started with in the 2019 Europa League final against Arsenal (they won 4-1).
checks: The starting eleven and shirt numbers agree in Wikipedia's match article, UEFA's line-ups feed and Transfermarkt's line-up page. Positions are Wikipedia's. Name spellings differ only in form: No. 33: Wikipedia Emerson Palmieri, UEFA Emerson, Transfermarkt Emerson; No. 11: Wikipedia Pedro, UEFA Pedro Rodriguez, Transfermarkt Pedro.
